mapper.insert: INSERT INTO memory_representation (id, tenant_id, owner_id, agent_id, representation_type, slug, title, summary, body, links, status, version, snapshot_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (CAST(#{id} AS uuid), #{tenantId}, #{ownerId}, CAST(#{agentId} AS uuid)NULL, #{representationType}, #{slug}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{body}, CAST(#{links} AS jsonb), #{status}, #{version}, CAST(#{snapshotId} AS uuid)NULL, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE memory_representation SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE snapshot_id = CAST(#{snapshotId} AS uuid)
mapper.select: SELECT *, links::text AS links FROM memory_representation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND (agent_id = CAST(#{agentId} AS uuid) OR agent_id IS NULL) AND to_tsvector('simple', COALESCE(title, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(summary, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(body, '')) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('simple', #{query}) ORDER BY ts_rank_cd( to_tsvector('simple', COALESCE(title, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(summary, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(body, '')), websearch_to_tsquery('simple', #{query}) ) DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
